Definition: Reported overall number of individuals per observed primate group in Mole National Park, Ghana (Wiafe 2019 abstract). Means for three species and a single observed group for Colobus vellerosus. Ten-minute observations from line transects; no adult-only restriction stated. Source-specific wild population data; not a species-wide mean. Sector-specific data and reported uncertainties are preserved separately. Overall means are not reconstructed from Table 3.
